name: Outlook Assistant
description: Connects AI assistants to Microsoft Outlook through Microsoft Graph: 22 tools for email, calendar, contacts, folders, rules, categories and mailbox settings, with dry-run previews, send limits, recipient allowlists and a read-only mode. Works with personal Outlook.com and work/school Microsoft 365 accounts using your own Azure app; device-code sign-in needs no client secret.

OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of your own Azure app registration. Not a secret. Optional: it can also be supplied at sign-in with the auth tool.
